plugins.name: designer
plugins.description: A working UI-design practice for Claude: derive one visual stance from the brief and commit to it in writing, build on semantic tokens, use real content, and check the result against an accessibility and taste floor. Includes an aesthetic-ingredient sampler, thirteen reference files, and an optional Essentialist designer persona distilled from the Bauhaus, Dieter Rams, and Jonathan Ive lineage. Reconstructs the workflow method observed in Figma Make; not affiliated with Figma, Inc.
